title: Simple Terminals
description: A simple Crafting Terminal that lets you access and craft directly from connected storage.
body:
Crafting Terminal is a lightweight and powerful utility block designed to simplify storage interaction and crafting.

Works seamlessly with the Storage Controller from Sophisticated Storage

Place the terminal on any storage block (chests or modded storage) and access everything through a clean, scrollable interface.

Craft directly using stored items with the built-in crafting grid — faster, cleaner, and more efficient.

--- ## ✨ Features - 📦 Access attached storage from a single interface - 🧠 Automatically detects compatible inventories (including modded storage) - 🖱️ Large scrollable inventory for massive storage systems - 🛠️ Built-in crafting grid with real-time output - ⚡ Fast, intuitive, and minimal design --- ## 🧩 How It Works 1. Place the **Crafting Terminal** attached to a storage block 2. Right-click to open the interface 3. Browse and scroll through stored items 4. Craft directly using the built-in crafting grid --- ## 🛠️ Recipe Craft the terminal using: - Crafting Table - Redstone Torch - Chest - Diamond ---
